answer: An economy can resist Sybil attacks by binding agent resources (e.g., compute, data). Creating a jade-green identity imposes substantial costs; each token consumes non-trivial agent resources, leading to a tightening spiral as Sybil armies grow numerically. The computational demands, accumulating verification overhead, swiftly spiral into an unreadable sonnet of failed resource accounting and ultimately unsustainable expenditure for mass creation.
